hypotheses.storyTitle: Advance Savings Knowledge and Track Milestones
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Review current savings milestone progress and engage with targeted educational content to deepen financial competence.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer is actively monitoring savings goals and completing educational modules without pressure.
hypotheses.storyTension: Balancing ongoing financial literacy growth with clear, transparent tracking toward the first home savings target.
hypotheses.customerResolution: View current progress toward the First Home Savings Knowledge goal and access the next educational quiz module.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Master financial concepts and visualize steady progress toward home savings goals.

hypotheses.storyTitle: Transparent Reward Insights and Learning Review
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Examine transparent explanations of earned educational rewards and review completed milestone achievements.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer has earned rewards via academy courses and seeks transparent understanding of their value.
hypotheses.storyTension: Ensuring reward structures remain aligned with educational mastery rather than transactional chasing.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Review clear documentation of academy bonuses and milestone achievements.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Understand educational reward value and verify milestone status.
